explain.summary: Chance that one of 25 entries wins 18 straight, from simulated seasons. Alone each survives 0.63%; if they were independent that would be 14.6%, but they share teams, so 9.8%.
explain.exposure: Board: 2 teams at 75%+, then 72%. Spreading further would lower P(at least one survives). If ARI wins, 15 entries go out together.

BAL.hedge: Its path overlaps the other 24 entries least: it survives 0.23% of the seasons where they are all dead, about level with LAC 0.22%, DET 0.21%, SEA 0.21%; a coin flip between them. On its own it would rank 10th.

notes: Games with no line yet use team ratings backed out of the posted Vegas spreads; inpredictable's ratings were not used because the page still shows last season (516 games played before week 1).
Road pick BAL: the line already includes home field.
Week 18 spots are shrunk 20% toward 50% for resting starters.
How much a posted line can still move is a default (about 1.4 pts one week out) until enough archived lines have closed to fit it.
Percentages for later weeks are deliberately pulled toward 50% because far-off games are trusted much less; the season survival percentages are not.
Survival percentages come from 100,000 simulated seasons; differences under about 0.06 points are noise.
A tie is a loss. Only this week's pick is a recommendation; later weeks re-solve every run.
